    Customize

    Customize your NovaskyChoose exactly which features and sections you want. Removed items disappear only for you, on this device, and you can bring them back any time.

    Account

    Browsing without an accountYour progress is saved on this device until you sign in.

    Appearance

    Accent colorChanges buttons, highlights and glows across the site. The logo images keep their own blue.
    BackgroundSpace, Nebula, Sunset, Aurora or pure black (saves battery on OLED screens).
    Font styleChanges the text style across the site.
    Card cornersHow round the cards and buttons look.
    Compact layoutLess spacing, so more fits on one screen.
    Reset appearancePuts color, background, font, corners and layout back to default.
    Start pageThe page Novasky opens on when you visit.

    Accessibility

    Text sizeMakes text across Novasky bigger. Saved on this device.
    Reduced motionCalms animations. Reload the page to fully apply.
    High contrastStronger colors and borders.
    Dyslexia-friendly fontChanges the font across the site.

    Keyboard shortcuts

    Press / to searchOpens search from anywhere on the site. Esc closes menus, search and full screen.

    Animation & performance

    Starry backgroundThe twinkling stars behind every page.
    Moving planetsPlanets orbit and spin in the Solar System. Off keeps them still.
    3D qualityLow is lighter on older phones and saves battery.

    Language

    Interface languageMenus and buttons. Lesson content is English for now.

    Backup & restore

    Download backupSaves your XP, achievements, saved facts, constellations and settings into one file.
    Restore from backupLoads a Novasky backup file. This replaces progress stored on this device.
    Reset all progressClears XP, achievements, saved facts and constellations stored on this device. If you are signed in, your cloud copy may load again at next sign-in.

    Privacy

    • On this device: your XP, achievements, saved facts, constellations, language and these settings are kept in your browser storage.
    • If you sign in: your progress is also stored in your Novasky account so it follows you across devices.
    • Leaderboard: only your username, avatar and XP are shown, plus your country only if you choose one.
    • Location: Novasky never asks for or shows your precise location.
    • Support messages: only what you type in the form is sent.
